questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Hands down
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Easily and without doubt**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"Hands down" **describes something that is easy and unquestionably true.

 
 
• Example - *The last time we played tennis he beat me **hands down**.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom **"Hands down"** is "**Easily and without doubt**"
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

questions.question:
**Choose the correct meaning of the underlined words :**

The law and order situation will only become worse in the state due to the riots, if the government does not do something right now to __nip it in the bud__.

options.text: To plan in detail to stop a threat
To destroy the problem in the initial stage only
To stop something harmful in the initial stage

questions.solution:
The correct answer is To stop something harmful in the initial stage

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **Nip (something) in the bud **is an idiom meaning *'to stop, cease, or prevent something at the beginning or early phase before it becomes too difficult or unmanageable*.'

 
 
• Ex:* Inflation will only get worse if the government doesn't do something right now to **nip it in the bud**.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the above sentence means:
 
 
• The government should take some steps at the earliest to prevent the law and order situation from worsening due to the riots.

 
 
 

Hence, option 4 is the correct choice.

questions.question:
Choose the option that gives the meaning of the underlined phrasal verbs/idioms:-

He had nothing to __fall back upon__ when the flood took away everything
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**to have resources, some help**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrasal verb '**fall back upon**' means to depend on someone or something that one has kept in reserve (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु पर निर्भर रहना जिसे किसी ने आरक्षित रखा है)

 
 
• Example - *With all of these medical bills, I just don't have any more money to fall back on.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the meaning of the underlined phrasal verb is '**to have resources, some help'.**

Hence, the correct answer is **option (3).**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• '**To back out**' means to break a promise or agreement (एक वादा या समझौता तोड़ने के लिए)

 
 
• Example - *To decide not to keep a commitment or promise: They backed out of the deal at the last minute.*

questions.question:
**Direction: Choose the meaning of the underlined phrase or idiom -**

She **__played ducks and drakes__** with her money.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"****spent lavishly****." **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The meaning of the idiom "played ducks and drakes" is to carelessly misuse, spent one’s wealth. (Idiom "Played ducks and drakes" का अर्थ किसी के धन का लापरवाही से दुरुपयोग करना।)

 
 
• Example:* Jane **played duck and drakes**__ with the financial system of company. *
 
 
 
• **Lavishly **means in a sumptuously rich, elaborate, or luxurious manner; in a very generous or extravagant manner; in profusion. (बहुत उदार या असाधारण तरीके से; बहुतायत में; एक समृद्ध रूप से, विस्तृत या शानदार तरीके से)
 
• So, the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom is** "spent lavishly."**
 
• *​​*Therefore, the correct option is Option 4.
